reference.quote: EITHER COLLECTS OR PROCESSES THE PERSONAL DATA OF ONE HUNDRED THOUSAND INDIVIDUALS OR MORE DURING A CALENDAR YEAR
reference.value: >= 100,000 individuals per calendar year: right-to-access duty in (5)(a) applies

reference.quote: COLLECTS AND PROCESSES THE PERSONAL DATA OF TWENTY-FIVE THOUSAND INDIVIDUALS OR MORE AND DERIVES REVENUE FROM, OR RECEIVES A DISCOUNT ON THE PRICE OF GOODS OR SERVICES FROM, THE SALE OF PERSONAL DATA
reference.value: >= 25,000 individuals plus revenue/discount from sale of personal data: right-to-access duty applies

reference.quote: A JOINT VENTURE OR PARTNERSHIP CONSISTING OF NO MORE THAN TWO BUSINESSES THAT SHARE CONSUMERS' PERSONAL DATA WITH EACH OTHER
reference.value: <= 2 businesses: joint venture covered by right-to-access duty

reference.quote: RECORD THE COMMENCEMENT AND CONCLUSION OF THE EMPLOYEE'S FULL WORK DAY, INCLUDING MEAL BREAKS AND REST BREAKS IN EXCESS OF THIRTY MINUTES
reference.value: > 30 minutes breaks: employer may require biometric consent as a condition of employment to record them

reference.quote: CONTROLS OR PROCESSES ANY AMOUNT OF BIOMETRIC IDENTIFIERS OR BIOMETRIC DATA REGARDLESS OF THE AMOUNT OF BIOMETRIC IDENTIFIERS OR BIOMETRIC DATA CONTROLLED OR PROCESSED ANNUALLY
reference.value: any amount (> 0) of biometric identifiers/data: CPA applies for biometric purposes regardless of the volume thresholds
